I begin serving as CEO of Syngenta Group today. As I do, I find myself thinking not about boardrooms, but about the small farming village where I grew up. That is where I saw firsthand the resilience, determination and hard work of farming families. What I learned there continues to shape how I see the world and my belief in the importance of agriculture in strengthening food security. A growing population, climate pressures and finite natural resources mean the world must produce more food, more sustainably. Helping farmers meet that challenge is why Syngenta Group exists. I feel fortunate to lead a company with deep Swiss roots, an international outlook, world-class science, and exceptional people. Yet what makes Syngenta Group truly special is our shared purpose: breakthroughs for farmers, in every field. I will lead with humility, openness and a willingness to listen. Staying close to farmers, customers, partners and colleagues will always be important to me. Together, we can help farmers achieve higher yields with lower impact and contribute to food security. Looking ahead, our strategic direction is clear, and our commitment to farmers, innovation and our people is as strong as ever. We have solid foundations, an important mission and a tremendous opportunity to help define the future of agriculture. Agriculture has always been about generations, not quarters. The seeds we plant today will become tomorrow's harvest.
